newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield America payment on target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield America payment on target.

text.p: Westfield America Trust, the operator of United States shopping malls which floated last year, said on Thursday that it expected its calendar 1997 distribution would be in line with its prospectus forecast.
Its half year distribution was 4.4 cents per unit.
The company's sole investment is a 50.8 percent stake in real estate investment trust Westfield America Inc which owns and operates 23 shopping centres in seven states.
Westfield America listed on the New York Stock Exchange in May this year, raising about US$300 million of new capital.
Westfield America Trust said its calendar 1997 first half net profit was A$35.49 million.
"The performance of the trust remains in line with the forecast contained in the 1996 prospectus issued at the time of the establishment of Westfield America Trust," it said.
